problem: Powerhouse structural changes can become difficult to understand when topology, skills, agents, intelligence and relations are not projected back into one canonical System Map.
root_cause: System Map writeback existed as a general repository-native rule but was not yet a dedicated discoverable skill with an explicit regression contract and canonical human document.
fix: Add machine-readable System Map governance policy
Make same-lineage System Map writeback automatic for all current and future chats/agents
prevention: Material topology changes cannot reach terminal green while System Map writeback is stale
Read-after-write must prove new/changed nodes and relations are discoverable
